dimension_description: This scale treats attention pragmatically as person-seconds of engaged time. That is more comparable and more additive than raw views, impressions, or clicks, and it lets a glance, a lecture, a concert, and a livestream all live on one axis. Views and audience counts can still appear as qualifiers or source notes.
